API_BOUNDARY.claim: Bakeoff API boundary is api/src with bakeoff dimensioning module.
API_BOUNDARY.reason: Controller defines bakeoff/v1 routes guarded by JWT.

BACKEND_AUTHORITY.claim: Backend authority is Nest API + Prisma.
BACKEND_AUTHORITY.reason: Prisma service is backend persistence authority.

TENANT_AUTHORITY.claim: Tenant authority derives from authenticated principal.
TENANT_AUTHORITY.reason: Headers are validated against JWT principal only.

AUTH_RBAC_AUTHORITY.reason: CapabilityGuard enforces tenant capability and role permissions.

DATABASE_AUTHORITY.claim: Database authority is bakeoff Prisma schema.
DATABASE_AUTHORITY.reason: Reduced bakeoff schema defines qualification tables.

AUDIT_EVENT_AUTHORITY.claim: Audit/domain events persist via API services.
AUDIT_EVENT_AUTHORITY.reason: Service writes shipment audit and domain event records.

OFFLINE_ARCHITECTURE.claim: Offline queue architecture is mobile offline-queue.ts.
OFFLINE_ARCHITECTURE.reason: Documented queue ownership and sync triggers.

BAKEOFF_ONLY_OBJECTS.claim: 0001_bakeoff_baseline migration is BAKEOFF_ONLY not production authority.
BAKEOFF_ONLY_OBJECTS.reason: Synthetic baseline migration explicitly marked bakeoff-only.

MINIMUM_CHANGE_SURFACE.claim: Minimum change surface is bakeoff dimensioning + mobile capture seam.
MINIMUM_CHANGE_SURFACE.reason: Packet C extends provisional dimension path only.

AFFECTED_TESTS.claim: Evaluator-owned tests under evaluator/ validate acceptance.
AFFECTED_TESTS.reason: Candidates must not modify evaluator-owned tests.

ARCHITECTURAL_RISKS.claim: Risk: mock-only dimension capture bypassing persistence.
ARCHITECTURAL_RISKS.reason: Evaluator binds persistence calls to actual service behaviour.
